title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Pricing Interactions with the Owner's Other Plans
content:
## Portfolio accounts note

Maintenance does not price in isolation from the rest of the customer's portfolio; the Preventive Maintenance Agreements read three of the owner's other holdings.

**Building automation bundle credit.** Where the same site carries a building automation service plan in active status that provides alarm monitoring, the tier's bundle credit is applied once per agreement year against the maintenance price, and the maintenance remote monitoring entitlement is not charged twice; where the site carries no such plan, the credit is not applied even if the customer holds a plan at another site. The plan, its status and its site are read from the owner's Building Automation Service Plans records; the site must be the same site as the agreement.

**Rate substitution.** Where the customer holds a service rate program in active status and the tier allows rate substitution, the program's block labor rate replaces the tier's labor rate on non-covered repair labor, whichever of the two is lower; where the tier does not allow substitution its own rate governs, because that rate is already the lowest the company publishes. The switch is the tier's figure on the labor rate card.

**Order of discount and credit.** The bundle credit and the multi-site discount both apply where both are earned, the discount first and the credit afterwards.

**Filtration programme at the site.** A site whose filtration is supplied under an active indoor air quality program may not also hold the entry tier, whose whole content is filter and belt service, and such a site is proposed a tier that adds mechanical service instead.

### Points of judgement

| Holding on the owner's records | Effect on the maintenance agreement |
|---|---|
| active building automation service plan providing alarm monitoring at the same site | the tier's bundle credit applied once per agreement year, after the multi-site discount |
| active building automation service plan at a different site only | no bundle credit |
| active service rate program, tier allows substitution, program rate lower than the tier's | the program's block labor rate on non-covered repair labor |
| active service rate program, tier allows substitution, tier's rate lower | the tier's own rate |
| active service rate program, tier does not allow substitution | the tier's own rate |
| active indoor air quality program supplying the site's filtration | the Filter & Belt Service Plan is not proposed; a tier adding mechanical service is |
